A box is being moved by a fork-lift truck. The total weight of the box is 3000N.

The force exerted by the fork-lift truck on the box is 3500N upwards.
What is the resultant force on the box?
A
500N downwards
B
500N upwards
C
6500N downwards
D
6500N upwards
